aurora-finance.title: Aurora Finance
aurora-finance.description: A real-time investment dashboard that turns dense market data into calm, legible decisions for private wealth clients.
aurora-finance.challenge: Clients were drowning in dense tables and lagging charts, making it hard to react to market moves with confidence in the moments that mattered most.
aurora-finance.solution: I rebuilt the data layer around streaming updates and virtualization, then designed a monochrome, chart-first interface with motion cues that highlight what changed — cutting time-to-insight dramatically.

nimbus-console.title: Nimbus Console
nimbus-console.description: A multi-tenant SaaS admin console for managing cloud infrastructure across teams, regions, and environments.
nimbus-console.challenge: Engineering teams needed a single console to manage infrastructure across dozens of regions without losing track of environment-specific risk.
nimbus-console.solution: I introduced a resizable, context-aware navigation system and a permissions-aware Bento layout so teams see exactly what matters to their role — nothing more, nothing less.

lumen-commerce.title: Lumen Commerce
lumen-commerce.description: A headless storefront for a premium goods retailer, built for speed, accessibility, and razor-sharp conversion.
lumen-commerce.challenge: The previous storefront was slow on mobile and the checkout funnel leaked customers at every step, hurting conversion during peak campaigns.
lumen-commerce.solution: I re-architected the storefront as a statically-optimized, edge-rendered experience with a redesigned one-page checkout, lifting mobile conversion and cutting load times by more than half.

orbit-analytics.title: Orbit Analytics
orbit-analytics.description: A data visualization platform that helps product teams explore user behavior through interactive, story-driven dashboards.
orbit-analytics.challenge: Analysts were exporting to spreadsheets just to make sense of the data because the existing charts couldn't support real exploratory analysis.
orbit-analytics.solution: I built a composable charting system with linked filtering and drill-down interactions, turning static reports into an explorable, story-driven dashboard experience.
